title: Scrovegni Chapel
geometryBasis: Native way 131997214 follows the standing chapel footprint, including the sacristy and polygonal apse. Small variation in long surveyed wall lines is represented by the mean nave wall planes.
sectionBasis: The 1904 engraving and Andrea Moschetti’s architectural survey establish the west trifora and round-headed entrance, brick Lombard frieze, narrow south windows and the arcaded belfry. The overall height follows the 17.78 m total-station survey. Intermediate heights and roof pitches are proportioned estimates.
limitations: Visible exterior only. The frescoed interior, separate Roman arena, removed portico and palace, and unrelated visitor buildings are outside the model scope.

Intermediate heights, brick colors, west window stone tracery, belfry fittings and small sacristy details are approximations. No historically conjectural portico or exterior frescoes are reconstructed.
